title: Phineas and Ferb
wiki_lead:
Phineas and Ferb is an American animated musical-comedy television series created by Dan Povenmire and Jeff "Swampy" Marsh for Disney Channel and Disney XD. The series originally aired on the networks for four seasons between 2007 and 2015, and returned for the first of two additional seasons in 2025. The series follows stepbrothers Phineas Flynn and Ferb Fletcher, who construct a grand project or embark on an adventure each day to make the most of their time on summer vacation, to the annoyance of Phineas' older sister Candace Flynn. Candace's attempts to expose their schemes to her mother always fail due to the fights between local evil scientist Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz and the boys' secret agent pet Perry the Platypus inadvertently removing all evidence of their work. The series follows a standard plot system, with several running gags occurring each episode.
Povenmire and Marsh conceived the characters while working together on animated programs The Simpsons and Rocko's Modern Life in the 1990s, and were inspired by the summers of their own childhoods. They developed the series together and pitched it to networks for 16 years before successfully selling it to The Walt Disney Company. Phineas and Ferb is produced by Disney Television Animation, and was originally broadcast as a one-episode preview on August 17, 2007, following the premiere of the made-for-television film High School Musical 2. It again previewed on September 28, 2007, and officially premiered on Disney Channel on February 1, 2008. The series originally concluded on June 12, 2015, before two new seasons were ordered in January 2023, with the fifth season premiering on Disney Channel on June 5, 2025, and on Disney+ the following day.
Phineas and Ferb is one of Disney Channel's most successful animated franchises. It received high viewership in the United States on cable television and influenced the development of merchandise, a live tour, spin-offs, and movies. A made-for-television film, Phineas and Ferb the Movie: Across the 2nd Dimension, aired in 2011, while a follow-up titled Phineas and Ferb the Movie: Candace Against the Universe was released on Disney+ in 2020. Critics praised the writing and humor of the show, citing its appeal to a wide range of ages. Others criticized its perceived lack of originality and formulaic approach. The series won a Daytime Emmy Award in 2010 for Outstanding Writing in Animation and several Primetime Emmy Awards for Outstanding Individual Achievement in Animation.

Premise
The series follows the adventures of stepbrothers Phineas Flynn and Ferb Fletcher. They live in the fictional city of Danville, USA, in an unspecified tri-state area, as they seek ways to occupy their time during their "104 days of summer vacation". Often these adventures involve elaborate, life-sized, and ostensibly dangerous construction projects, which are usually unrealistic in scale given the protagonists' ages (and sometimes physically impossible). grok_lead: Phineas and Ferb is an American animated musical comedy television series created by Dan Povenmire and Jeff "Swampy" Marsh that originally premiered on Disney Channel on August 17, 2007. The show centers on inventive stepbrothers Phineas Flynn and Ferb Fletcher, who spend their 104 days of summer vacation building elaborate projects and contraptions in their backyard, often oblivious to the chaos they cause, while their overzealous older sister Candace constantly schemes to "bust" them by alerting their parents. Running parallel to the main storyline is a B-plot featuring the family's pet platypus, Perry (Agent P), who leads a double life as a secret agent thwarting the absurd world-domination schemes of the bumbling evil scientist Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz. The series aired for four seasons from 2007 to 2015, comprising 222 episodes, each typically structured around the dual narratives that converge in humorous resolutions, interspersed with original songs and recurring gags like Doofenshmirtz's "-inator" inventions. In January 2023, Disney announced a revival with two additional 20-episode seasons, with season 5 premiering on Disney Channel on June 5, 2025, the first 10 episodes releasing on Disney+ the following day, and additional episodes airing through November 2025, with the second half of the season scheduled for 2026, continuing the adventures amid the stepbrothers' final summer before high school. Voiced by a talented ensemble including Vincent Martella as Phineas, Thomas Sangster (original series) and David Errigo Jr. (revival) as Ferb, Ashley Tisdale as Candace, and Povenmire himself as Doofenshmirtz, the show emphasizes themes of creativity, family bonds, and optimism, earning critical acclaim for its clever writing, animation, and musical numbers. Phineas and Ferb received multiple Emmy Awards, including wins for Outstanding Individual Achievement in Animation in 2011, along with numerous nominations for music, writing, and short-format programs, and accolades from the Annie Awards for its animation excellence. The franchise expanded into films like Phineas and Ferb the Movie: Across the 2nd Dimension (2011) and Phineas and Ferb The Movie: Candace Against the Universe (2020), specials, video games, and merchandise, cementing its status as a cornerstone of Disney's animated programming with a global fanbase.
